factors.label: US equities
factors.unit: fractional price return of SPY (−0.20 = S&P 500 down 20%)

factors.label: Treasury rates
factors.unit: fractional price return of IEF, 7–10y Treasuries (−0.075 ≈ yields up 100bp at ~7.5y duration)

factors.label: Credit spreads
factors.unit: high-yield bond return in excess of Treasuries (−0.10 = HY underperforms by 10%)
factors.description: Corporate credit risk. Negative = spreads widen.

factors.label: US dollar
factors.unit: fractional return of the dollar index fund UUP (+0.05 = dollar up 5%)

factors.label: Crude oil
factors.unit: fractional return of the oil fund USO (+0.30 = oil up 30%)
factors.description: Energy price shock. USO carries futures roll cost.

factors.label: Equity volatility
factors.unit: log change in the VIX index (+0.69 = VIX doubles)

factors.label: Gold
factors.unit: fractional price return of GLD (+0.10 = gold up 10%)

scenarios.label: Equity crash −20%
scenarios.source: A bear-market-sized fall in the S&P 500.

scenarios.label: Rates +200bp
scenarios.source: Parallel +200bp move, the standard supervisory rate shock (BCBS IRRBB), at ~7.5y duration.

scenarios.label: Credit spreads blow out
scenarios.source: High yield underperforming Treasuries by 15%, close to the Feb–Mar 2020 move.

scenarios.label: Dollar spike +8%
scenarios.source: Comparable to the dollar rallies of late 2008 and 2022.

scenarios.label: Volatility spike (VIX ×2.5)
scenarios.source: VIX roughly 16 → 40, as in Aug 2015, Feb 2018 and Aug 2024.

scenarios.label: Stagflation
scenarios.source: Stocks and bonds fall together while oil rises, as in 2022.

scenarios.label: Global Financial Crisis
scenarios.source: Factor moves actually realised 2007-10-09 → 2009-03-09. Factors without data in that window are filled from crisis correlations.

scenarios.label: 2011 US downgrade
scenarios.source: Factor moves actually realised 2011-07-22 → 2011-10-03. Factors without data in that window are filled from crisis correlations.

scenarios.label: 2015 China devaluation
scenarios.source: Factor moves actually realised 2015-08-10 → 2015-08-25. Factors without data in that window are filled from crisis correlations.

scenarios.label: 2018 Q4 selloff
scenarios.source: Factor moves actually realised 2018-09-20 → 2018-12-24. Factors without data in that window are filled from crisis correlations.

scenarios.label: COVID-19 crash
scenarios.source: Factor moves actually realised 2020-02-19 → 2020-03-23. Factors without data in that window are filled from crisis correlations.

scenarios.label: 2022 rate-hike bear market
scenarios.source: Factor moves actually realised 2022-01-03 → 2022-10-12. Factors without data in that window are filled from crisis correlations.

scenarios.label: 2023 regional-bank stress
scenarios.source: Factor moves actually realised 2023-03-08 → 2023-03-24. Factors without data in that window are filled from crisis correlations.

assumptions: Loadings are OLS regressions of weekly returns on the seven factors over up to three years, with Newey–West standard errors.
A stress is first-order in the factors for stocks and funds; options are fully repriced (Black–Scholes, European exercise, no dividends).
Implied volatility moves in parallel by the scenario's change in VIX points.
Factors without a specified shock are set to their expected move given the specified ones, using correlations measured in past crises.
The margin view applies a flat 25% maintenance requirement to long market value. Your broker's house rules are not known and may be stricter.
Confidence ranges cover loading-estimation error and single-name risk for the stock book; they do not cover model error or option repricing error.
